# dsh-checkpoints

Persistent, per-turn workspace checkpoints with a previewed, approved, and
undoable revert — the "Cu

rsor checkpoints" behaviour for the DeepSeek Harness
Web UI.

The shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes` plugin records what a turn
changed and shows its di

ff, but its snapshots live in the Session's temporary
directory and disappear when the Session or th

e Host ends, and it offers no
revert. This bundle adds both: a **shadow git repository** that surviv

es
restarts, and a **revert** that can be applied to one file or to a whole turn.
## Install

The package is a **bundle**: installing it also selects it in the profile, and
a running Host loads
it after one restart.
### From git
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Ask the agent to install that bundle — the Creator preset's `plugin_manager`
tool takes it as `insta

ll_bundle`'s `target` — or paste it into
**Plugins → Add**. A tag keeps the instruction readable; pi

n a commit
(`#<40-hex sha>`) instead when the target must be immutable.
### From npm
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### From a local checkout
Point `install_bundle` at this directory's absolute path.
### Upgrading

There is no upgrade path yet: remove the bundle, then install the newer tag or
commit. Checkpoints u

nder `$DSH_HOME/workspace-checkpoints` survive both, so the
conversation history keeps working.
## What it does

- **Records** a snapshot of the workspace at `turn/start` and again at
`turn/end` into a shadow repo

sitory under the Harness home, and persists the
turn's changed-file list in a small catalog next to

it.
- **Serves** that history to the Web page: one row under each completed turn,
plus the `/api/che

ckpoints.*` routes.
- **Offers two actions per turn**, both behind one dialog that lists the files,

previews each one's unified diff, and writes only the files you tick — all of
them or just one:
- **

Undo this turn's changes** — puts back the files *this turn* changed, at
their content from the star

t of the turn; files the turn did not touch are
left alone.
- **Revert to this turn** — makes the wo

rkspace look like the *end* of that
turn: everything up to it is kept, every change any later turn m

ade is
dropped. Hidden on the newest turn, where nothing follows it yet.

The overwritten state is snapshotted first, so either action can itself be
undone.
- **Exposes** the

same operation to the model as the `workspace_checkpoint`
tool, which asks the DSH approval answere
rs before it writes anything.
## Mount
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Default | Meaning |
| `storeDir` | `$DSH_HOME/workspace-checkpoints` | Where the shadow repositories and the catalog liv

e. |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Milliseconds one git command may run. |
| `outputMaxBytes` | `8388608

` | Bytes of git output retained per command. |
| `maxFileBytes` | `2097152` | Largest snapshot blob

the revert will write or diff; a bigger one is reported as `unsupported: oversized`. |
| `maxDiffBy

tes` | `524288` | Bytes of unified-diff text one preview may carry. |
| `maxTurnsPerSession` | `300`

| Turns the catalog keeps per Session before the oldest are forgotten. |
| `planTtlMs` | `600000` |
How long an unapplied preview stays valid. |

The bundle deliberately declares **no `Config` schema**: a bundle installed from
a workspace directo

ry resolves its imports from that directory, so it cannot
depend on the schema library the Host ship

s. Invalid values fall back to these
defaults instead of failing activation.
## Safety model

- The user's repository is never written. Every snapshot command runs with
`GIT_DIR` at the shadow r

epository and its own persistent index, and the
user's object store is attached only as a read-only

`GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES` entry. No ref, index entry, object, or
commit is created there; `

test/integration-git.mjs` hashes the whole `.git`
tree before and after to prove it.
- `core.autocrl

f=false` and `core.safecrlf=false` with an empty
`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` keep stored and restored bytes

exact, whatever the user's
global git configuration says.
- A working directory outside any reposito

ry still gets checkpoints: the shadow
repository is self-contained and needs no user repository at a

ll.
- A revert is two-phase. `/api/checkpoints.plan` reads only; the returned
`planId` is single-use

, expires after `planTtlMs`, and `/api/checkpoints.restore`
refuses it when any planned file changed

while the preview was open.
Every path is resolved against the recorded workspace root and rejected

when it
is absolute or escapes it.
- The state a revert overwrites is snapshotted first, and `/api/

checkpoints.undo`
restores it.
- The agent tool routes the same write through `ctx.approval.request(

ce requires an open turn; the Web route is therefore gated by its
own explicit preview-and-confirm h

andshake instead, which the user performs in
the dialog.
- Snapshot blobs larger than `maxFileBytes`

are listed but never written; the
dialog marks them "not revertable".
## Routes

All are exact routes on `ctx.connection.fetch`, below `/api`, so they sit inside
Connection's authen
tication fence and answer no-cache JSON.
| Route | Method | Purpose |

| `/api/checkpoints.turns?sessionId=` | GET | Every recorded turn of one Session. |
| `/api/checkpoi
nts.plan` | POST | Prepare a revert preview (`{sessionId, turn, side?, paths?}`): `side: 'start'` (d
efault) undoes that turn's own files, `side: 'end'` restores the workspace to the end of that turn.

|
| `/api/checkpoints.diff?planId=&path=` | GET | One file's unified diff for that preview. |
| `/ap

i/checkpoints.restore` | POST | Apply a preview (`{planId}`). |
| `/api/checkpoints.undo` | POST | U
ndo an applied revert (`{undoId}`). |
## The turn row

Each completed turn of the conversation carries one row with one action, chosen
by the turn's positi

h completed turn of the conversation carries one row with one action, chosen
by the turn's position:

| Turn | Action | Baseline | File list |

| newest | Undo this turn's changes | the start of this turn | the files *this turn* changed |
